description: YAML corpus for spike 0.3b: docs/research/yaml.md §5 rows (family spike) and the PLAN.md §6.3 mutation families over a base Marathonfile (family mutation), through marathon's Marathonfile mapper (profile P1, time provider fixed at 2026-10-12T00:00:00Z).

schema.id: row id (spike: Cnn + letter; emit: C60x; mutation: M-<path>-<mutation>)
schema.input: the YAML text; absent when input_gen is given. Emit rows: the Marathonfile (C60c) or the value serialised, in canonical form
schema.input_gen: for large inputs: the text is the concatenation of each [segment, count] repeated count times
schema.env: mutation rows: the environment for ${...} substitution
schema.tokens: {tokens: [...], error: null | {class, message}}; mutation rows other than M-base store {samePrefix, sameSuffix, tokens, error}: the stream is M-base's first samePrefix tokens, then tokens, then M-base's last sameSuffix tokens; a token is [code, text] or [code, text, value], codes { } [ ] F(field) S(string) I(int) D(float) T F0(false) N E(embedded, base64), an optional trailing object holds anchor/tag; texts over 256 chars (error messages: 4000) are replaced by <N chars, sha256 …>
schema.emit: emit rows only: {ok: YAML} written by the Marathonfile mapper (ConfigurationFactory's mapper, the path of ConfigurationFactory.serialize) or {error}
schema.bind: spike/strategy: map target -> {ok: canonical value of k (or of the object)} | {nullDocument: true} | {error: {class, message}}; mutation: {Configuration: {stage, error, diff}} where diff lists [path, base value, value] against row M-base and paths under the Marathonfile directory read <MARATHONFILE_DIR>

generator: tools/oracle/module (run tools/oracle/jcompat-tables or the corpus wrappers to regenerate)
